designSystems.name: maude
designSystems.description: Unified Pro Studio — the canonical Maude design system. Dark-first cool-neutral elevation ladder (hue 255) framing a dotted infinite canvas; ONE confident indigo accent (oklch 0.68 0.18 268), one job per surface. One shared chrome material across panels/toolbars/inspectors/layer-trees; mono (JetBrains/Geist) is first-class for part-numbers, coordinates and inspector fields. Between Zed and Webflow, more cohesive. Dense but calm; chrome frames the canvas, never competes. Two-theme equal (dark studio default / light reading-handoff).

designSystems.name: maude-v2
designSystems.description: Light glass with a spark — the Maude v2.0.0 redesign DS. Designer-first, light-default (dark equal-status): the canvas is the whole window and all chrome floats over it as frosted ~88%-opaque islands with soft concentric radii that fold into a single icon. Azure (oklch 0.53 0.175 238 — darkened from the moodboard 0.60 for AA) is functional only — action, selection, focus; a vermilion spark (oklch 0.66 0.20 36) is reserved for the AI; colour lives on the canvas (object palette for stickies/shapes). Native SF Pro type with SF Pro Rounded for playful surfaces; mono only in Advanced. Gentle motion with a drop of spring for playful moments. Nothing is deleted — developer detail hides in the icon menu, ⌘K or a panel's Advanced section.
